claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Innokin iTaste VV v3 800mAh 4C as a 800mAh preset with a 4C runtime rating.
The Innokin iTaste VV v3 documentation identifies an internal lithium-ion battery; a contemporaneous manual variant describes it as polymer.
The exact catalog entry Innokin iTaste VV v3 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-05-25 or earlier.

safetyFindings.summary: Surviving evidence does not fully resolve the internal cell and current-limit interpretation.
